name: Rengokutou Mary Skelter
original_name: 恋獄塔めありーすけるたー
source:
Set in a private high school called Blood High, many students with strange abilities study and enjoy their youth at the school. The spooky Jail Tower looms over the school grounds. There are rumors that if a couple confesses to each other under the Tower, they will be bound forever and ascend to the top.

The story begins with Jack, who has a surprise birthday party coming up that he has to pretend he doesn't know about and choose a girl to confess to under the Jail Tower.

[From [url=http://maryskelternightmares.fandom.com/wiki/Love_Prison_Tower_Mary_Skelter]Mary Skelter Wiki[/url]]

A spin-off that was included as a pre-order bonus for Mary Skelter 2 on the Playstation 4. It will also be included in Mary Skelter: Finale's "Adventure Mode".
translation:
故事發生在一所名為私立血式學園高等學校的高中。許多擁有奇異能力的學生在這裡學習，享受青春時光。一座陰森的監獄塔矗立在校園之中。傳說，只要一對戀人在塔下互訴心意，兩人便會永遠相伴，並登上塔頂。

故事開始時，傑克即將迎來一場驚喜生日派對。他得假裝對此毫不知情，還要選一位女孩，在監獄塔下向她告白。

［摘自[url=http://maryskelternightmares.fandom.com/wiki/Love_Prison_Tower_Mary_Skelter]Mary Skelter Wiki[/url]］

本作為衍生作品，曾作為PlayStation 4版《神獄塔 斷罪瑪麗 2》的預購特典附贈，也將收錄於《神獄塔 斷罪瑪麗 Finale》的「冒險模式」中。
